HEADING: MCP Server Setup
INTRO: FastComments exposes a stateless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants and agentic clients call the FastComments API directly. Each tool maps to an existing public API endpoint and is generated from the OpenAPI spec, so anything the REST API can do, an MCP client can do.
WHAT_IS_MCP_BODY: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for letting LLM clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, and others) invoke server-side tools. The FastComments server runs over HTTP and requires no session state. Clients sign in with OAuth, or you can embed an API key in the URL.
OAUTH_BODY: Give any MCP client the plain endpoint below. The client registers itself, sends you here to sign in and approve access, and receives a token bound to this account. No API key is copied anywhere, and you can revoke the connection at any time.
